description: Start a service plugin with specified configuration
embedding_description: Bring up a service plugin at runtime. Boot a background service that was not started at platform startup. Initialize and start a named service with its config. Spin up a worker or daemon plugin on demand. Launch a service interface implementation. Bring an inactive service online without restarting the solet.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Service startup result with keys: success (boolean indicating startup status), service_name (name of the started service), message (status description)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Starts a service plugin with specified configuration, loading the plugin, initializing its dependencies, and beginning its operational loop
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ServiceNotFoundError: The requested service plugin is not installed or registered. ConfigurationError: Invalid or missing configuration parameters. DependencyError: Required service dependencies are not available. AlreadyRunningError: The service is already running.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For service not found: Check the service name spelling and verify the plugin is installed. For configuration errors: Review the service's required configuration parameters. For dependency errors: Start required dependency services first. For already running: Use stop_service first if a restart is needed.
